payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_the_top_up_sets_aside_a_live_rebuttals_answer_and_error stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/record/migrate.py. The claim was "`saffron migrate`'s top-up sets aside a `rebuttal` fact's `answer` and `error` keys, as it sets aside a `gate_result`'s own keys. So a held `rebuttal` fact that carries them, an empty error included, agrees with the one `migrate` derives for the same row. The same keys on a `finding` fact still disagree, and so does a held `rebuttal` whose `verdict` differs. No value is backfilled.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
